title: Name length buckets
statementMd:
How many students have a name shorter than 12 characters, from 12 to 15, and longer than 15? Show a `bucket` label (`short`, `medium`, `long`) and the count.

Expected columns: `bucket`, `students`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT CASE WHEN LENGTH(name) < 12 THEN 'short' WHEN LENGTH(name) <= 15 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'long' END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS students FROM students GROUP BY bucket;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
